items.title: TOBench: A Task-Oriented Omni-Modal Benchmark for Real-World Tool-Using Agents
items.title_zh: TOBench：面向真实工具使用智能体的任务导向全模态基准
items.summary: The Pi3AI paper introduces a task-oriented omni-modal tool-use benchmark and evaluation harness with 100 executable tasks across customer service and intelligent creation, including closed-loop verification of intermediate artifacts. Its Hugging Face listing had 9 upvotes and its code repository 5 stars.

items.title: Code as Agent Harness
items.title_zh: 代码即智能体运行框架
items.summary: This survey frames code as the operational substrate for agent reasoning, action, environment modeling and execution-based verification, organized around the harness interface, harness mechanisms and multi-agent scaling. Its Hugging Face listing drew 225 upvotes and its companion repository 721 stars.

items.title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
items.title_zh: SkillsVote：从收集、推荐到演化的智能体技能生命周期治理
items.summary: SkillsVote is a lifecycle-governance framework that profiles a million-scale open-source corpus of agent skills, then collects, recommends and evolves reusable skills for long-horizon LLM agents. Its Hugging Face listing drew 79 upvotes and its code repository 306 stars.

items.title: Show HN: Forge – Guardrails take an 8B model from 53% to 99% on agentic tasks
items.title_zh: Show HN：Forge —— 护栏把 8B 模型在智能体任务上的成绩从 53% 提升到 99%
items.summary: Antoine Zambelli released Forge, an open-source reliability layer for self-hosted LLM tool calling that adds retry nudges, step enforcement and VRAM-aware context management. It reportedly lifts an 8B model from about 53% to 99% on multi-step agentic workflows; the Show HN post drew 687 points and 252 comments.

items.title: Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Cross-Entity Financial Sentiment Analysis: A Comparative Study
items.title_zh: 面向跨实体金融情感分析的图增强检索：比较研究
items.summary: The study builds a sentiment-weighted knowledge graph of 59 equity entities from 255 news articles and compares two-hop Graph-RAG with vector-only retrieval on 100 grounded queries. Graph-RAG improved entity recall by 6.4% and answer relevancy by 11.7%, with gains concentrated in relational questions, at a 22.6% latency cost.

items.title: OProver: A Unified Framework for Agentic Formal Theorem Proving
items.title_zh: OProver：智能体形式化定理证明的统一框架
items.summary: OProver is a unified framework for agentic formal theorem proving in Lean 4 in which failed attempts are revised using retrieved compiler-verified proofs and Lean feedback, trained through continued pretraining and iterative post-training. Its Hugging Face listing drew 33 upvotes and its code repository 27 stars.

items.title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind
items.title_zh: OSCToM：面向高阶心理理论的强化学习引导对抗生成
items.summary: OSCToM generates observer-self belief conflicts using reinforcement learning, an extended domain-specific language and compositional surrogate models. OSCToM-8B reaches 76% accuracy on the information-asymmetric FANToM benchmark, compared with 0.2% reported by ExploreToM, and its data-synthesis procedure is 6x more efficient.

items.title: ZEBRA: Zero-shot Budgeted Resource Allocation for LLM Orchestration
items.title_zh: ZEBRA：面向 LLM 编排的零样本预算资源分配
items.summary: ZEBRA treats multi-phase budget allocation as a continuous nonlinear knapsack problem, with an LLM controller estimating per-phase utility curves and a water-filling search returning the split. At half the unconstrained budget it recovered 94.4% of unconstrained quality on APPS, versus 88.1% for LLM-direct allocation.

items.title: Code-as-Room: Generating 3D Rooms from Top-Down View Images via Agentic Code Synthesis
items.title_zh: Code-as-Room：通过智能体代码合成从俯视图图像生成 3D 房间
items.summary: Code-as-Room is an MLLM agentic framework that converts top-down view images into executable Blender code through a structured execution harness with cross-stage memory, avoiding the looping seen in prior image-conditioned agents. Its Hugging Face listing drew 40 upvotes and its code repository 241 stars.

items.title: Mechanics of Bias and Reasoning: Interpreting the Impact of Chain-of-Thought Prompting on Gender Bias in LLMs
items.title_zh: 偏见与推理的机制：解读思维链提示对 LLM 性别偏见的影响
items.summary: The study combines benchmark evaluation with mechanistic interpretability and reasoning-chain failure analysis to test whether chain-of-thought prompting reduces gender bias. It finds CoT does not consistently narrow the bias gap, with bias still embedded in hidden representations and apparent gains stemming from memorization rather than understanding.

items.title: open-mercato/cezar
items.title_zh: open-mercato/cezar：并行运行多种 AI 编程智能体的编排器
items.summary: cezar is an open-source TypeScript orchestrator and agent development environment for running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and other AI coding agents in parallel, either locally or continuously on a user's own server. It had 835 stars and 156 forks.

items.title: Gemini CLI will stop working from June 18, 2026
items.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将于 2026 年 6 月 18 日起停止工作
items.summary: Google announced that Gemini CLI will be sunset in favor of Antigravity CLI, described as a more robust, agent-first platform built for the multi-agent complexity of 2026. The change takes effect June 18, 2026; the Hacker News post drew 406 points and 209 comments.
